examples.name: Sample — catastrophe-review-2025_p4
paragraphs: Bins every $500, labels every $1 000, a printed catch-all, and one labeled position (1500) with no bar. Full coverage is 29 rows: 1500 holds 0; the unlabeled bins are labeled by their axis values (2000, 3000 …); every count is an estimate against the 20-unit grid. The catch-all keeps its printed space (> 15000). The value axis title heads the single value column; the category axis title heads the label column.

examples.name: Sample — goal cards with progress bars
paragraphs: Three goal cards separated by rules. Each bar marks its current value (40%, 7, 42%, each with the year 2024 beneath it) against a scale from its start (0%, 0) to its target (100% with 2030 Target, 8 with 2025 Target). The rows follow the axis: start, current value, target. The third card's scale end-points fall below the crop and are not shown, so its table holds only the current value.
